integrity: The sharp constant follows from an exact collision identity and a complete equality analysis. Finite computation is corroborative only.
limitations: Odd characteristic; the theorem concerns only the two-dimensional anisotropic norm-one conic and the L2-to-L4 extension norm. The verifier samples prime fields; the proof covers all odd prime powers.
title: Sharp fourth-moment extension on the anisotropic finite-field norm-one conic
